scenes.text: If you fell through a tunnel across the whole Earth...
you would accelerate for 42 minutes, then slow to a stop.
At the centre you would be weightless - for one perfect instant.
Then you would fall all the way back up.
And do it again. Forever, if nothing stopped you.
Follow What If Physics for more.
